capture.prompt: Scan the asset's QR code or barcode

business_logic.description: Check a scanned QR/barcode against this line's asset and fill it in as Found
business_logic.spec: Row action on a Verified Assets line. The runtime asks for a scan first (camera or external scanner, capture.field SCANNED_ASSET_CODE) and posts it with the line FLAT (VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO, ASSET_CODE, PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND, VERIFIED_DATE; also lowercase keys). Steps: (1) Empty scan -> error. (2) Read the cycle from FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION; not found or STATUS not PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS -> error. (3) The scan matches this line when it equals the asset's stored FAM_ASSET_REGISTER.QR_BARCODE_TAG or, once unwrapped (URL ?ASSET_CODE= / last path segment, ASSET_CODE=<code>, JSON {asset_code}, FAM|<code>|..., FAM-<code>), equals ASSET_CODE (case-insensitive); otherwise error naming both codes. (4) A line already recorded as another status (NOT_FOUND / DAMAGED / EXTRA_UNREGISTERED) is left unchanged with a prompt. (5) Otherwise return updates PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = FOUND and VERIFIED_DATE = today, plus a prompt. Writes nothing - the user saves the record.

business_logic.description: Check a typed asset code against this line's asset and fill it in as Found
business_logic.spec: Row action on a Verified Assets line. The runtime asks the user to type the asset code first (capture.field ENTERED_ASSET_CODE) and posts it with the line FLAT (VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO, ASSET_CODE, PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND, VERIFIED_DATE; also lowercase keys). Steps: (1) Empty code -> error. (2) Read the cycle from FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION; not found or STATUS not PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS -> error. (3) The trimmed code must equal this line's ASSET_CODE (case-insensitive); otherwise error naming both codes. (4) A line already recorded as another status (NOT_FOUND / DAMAGED / EXTRA_UNREGISTERED) is left unchanged with a prompt. (5) Otherwise return updates PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = FOUND and VERIFIED_DATE = today, plus a prompt. Writes nothing - the user saves the record.

business_logic.description: Find the verification line a scanned QR/barcode belongs to and answer it filled in as Found
business_logic.spec: Scan session on the Verified Assets lines (capture loop, field SCANNED_ASSET_CODE, match ASSET_CODE). Payload: SCANNED_ASSET_CODE plus the parent key VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO (also lowercase keys). Steps: (1) Empty scan -> error. (2) Read the cycle from FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION; not found or STATUS not PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS -> error. (3) Find the line of this cycle whose asset matches the scan: the scan equals the asset's FAM_ASSET_REGISTER.QR_BARCODE_TAG, or, once unwrapped (URL ?ASSET_CODE= / last path segment, ASSET_CODE=<code>, JSON {asset_code}, FAM|<code>|..., FAM-<code>), equals ASSET_CODE (case-insensitive). None -> error "Asset <code> is not in the current asset list of cycle <no>." (4) A line already recorded (any PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND) -> error naming that status and its verified date. (5) Otherwise return a ONE-ROW list for the line: ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, the asset details (category, serial no, make, model, asset status), PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = FOUND and VERIFIED_DATE = today. Writes nothing - the user confirms on screen and saves the record.

unit_test.note: Execution runs over cycles created by Plan Asset Verification List. The fixture picks an existing PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS cycle rather than creating one.
